items.en: Qatar Says Hormuz Draft Deal Is Circulating as Trump Warns Iran Will Be 'Hit Very Hard'
items.zh: 卡達稱荷姆茲協議草案傳閱中，川普警告伊朗「不開通就重擊」
items.summary: Qatar's foreign ministry said talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz are in 'very progressive stages', with draft language circulating among the parties. President Trump said the waterway would reopen 'very soon' or Iran would be 'hit very hard'. Iranian state media pushed back, saying any Iran-Oman understanding has 'no connection' to reopening the strait. A Gulf official put the odds of a deal by Friday at 50-50. Markets treated the standoff as an energy story, with oil rising but equities near records.

items.en: US Has Burned Through Nearly 80% of Key Missile Interceptors in the Iran War
items.zh: 美軍關鍵攔截飛彈已消耗近八成，庫存亮紅燈
items.summary: Sources told CNN the US military has expended almost 80% of the interceptors for one of its principal missile-defence systems during the conflict with Iran, leaving several air-defence stockpiles 'dangerously low'. Commanders warn replenishment will take years at current production rates, a constraint that shapes how long Washington can sustain the campaign. The disclosure lands as US, Qatari and Omani officials try to convert a fragile pause into a durable ceasefire covering the Strait of Hormuz.

items.en: Arson Suspect Arrested as Spokane Wildfires Destroy About 850 Buildings
items.zh: 斯波坎野火燒毀約 850 棟建物，縱火嫌犯落網
items.summary: Authorities arrested a man on suspicion of deliberately setting one of three blazes ravaging the Spokane area of Washington state. The fires have destroyed roughly 850 buildings and forced about 67,000 people from their homes. Cooler weather on Wednesday finally let crews gain ground, though tens of thousands remain evacuated. More than a dozen fires are burning across Washington and Oregon in what officials call the Pacific Northwest's worst season in over 30 years.

items.en: Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan's Democratic Senate Primary Over Haley Stevens
items.zh: El-Sayed 擊敗 Stevens，拿下密西根民主黨參議員初選
items.summary: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed defeated Congresswoman Haley Stevens in Michigan's closely watched Democratic Senate primary, a result NBC called first and the AP and CNN later confirmed. The race had become a proxy fight between the party's progressive and establishment wings, and El-Sayed's win gives progressives a marquee Senate nominee in a battleground state. Attention now turns to whether the party can consolidate behind him ahead of November's general election.

items.en: Houthi Missile Strike on a Saudi Tanker Lifts Oil and Sinks an Indian-Flagged Vessel Off Yemen
items.zh: 胡塞飛彈襲沙烏地油輪推升油價，葉門外海印度籍船遭擊沉
items.summary: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi rebels said they hit a Saudi oil tanker off Yanbu, a key crude export hub, while an Indian-flagged vessel was struck and sunk off Yemen's coast. Brent climbed 1.56% to $79.82 and WTI rose 0.75% to $76.34. Gold jumped 1.83% to $4,228 and silver 2.59% to $61.81 as investors sought safety. The attacks tempered the week's optimism that Middle East tensions were finally easing.

items.en: Claude Opus 5 Still Leads the Leaderboard as Anthropic Ships Enterprise Inference Hooks
items.zh: Claude Opus 5 續居榜首，Anthropic 推出企業版 inference hooks
items.summary: Claude Opus 5, released July 24, remains top of Artificial Analysis's rebased leaderboard after Anthropic's unusually dense run of releases: Opus 4.8 in late May, Fable 5 and Mythos 5 on June 9, Sonnet 5 on June 30. In August, Anthropic began beta-testing inference hooks for Enterprise customers, giving compliance teams real-time data-loss-prevention enforcement across Claude chat, Claude Code and Cowork. Mariano-Florentino Cuellar also joined on August 4 as Chief Global Affairs Officer.

items.en: Gemini 3.5 Pro Slips Further Behind Schedule While GPT-5.6 Stays in Limited Preview
items.zh: Gemini 3.5 Pro 再度延期，GPT-5.6 仍限量預覽
items.summary: Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro remains unreleased. Bloomberg reported on July 16 that it is running months behind internal schedule and falling short on coding benchmarks in particular. OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 on June 26 to roughly twenty organisations under a restricted access list and has not gone wide. If either ships in August it would be the first genuine head-to-head test against Opus 5, which has won every monthly market since February.

items.en: Microsoft and Google Push Into Coding Models to Challenge Anthropic and OpenAI
items.zh: 微軟、Google 加碼程式碼模型，正面叫陣 Anthropic 與 OpenAI
items.summary: Microsoft and Google are both pushing purpose-built coding models to contest the segment Anthropic and OpenAI have dominated. Coding has become the highest-value proving ground for frontier labs because it converts directly into enterprise seats and agent workloads. The competitive pressure is one reason Google's Gemini coding-benchmark shortfall matters more than a headline delay: it is the axis on which enterprise buyers are currently comparing vendors.

items.en: Ohio State and Oregon Top the College Football Preseason Coaches' Poll
items.zh: 俄亥俄州大與奧勒岡並列大學美式足球季前教練票選榜首
items.summary: Ohio State and Oregon headed the college football preseason coaches' poll released on August 5, setting the early narrative for a season that kicks off later this month. Preseason polls carry real weight in the expanded playoff era because early ranking shapes strength-of-schedule arguments in December. Both programmes return substantial talent, and their placement above traditional SEC powers reflects how quickly the Big Ten's balance of power has shifted.

items.en: Alexandra Eala Becomes the First Filipino Player to Win a WTA Tour Title
items.zh: Alexandra Eala 成為首位奪下 WTA 巡迴賽冠軍的菲律賓球員
items.summary: Alexandra Eala won the DC Open to become the first player from the Philippines to lift a WTA Tour singles trophy. The 21-year-old's breakthrough follows a steady climb through the rankings and makes her the most prominent tennis figure Southeast Asia has produced in years. The result also strengthens her seeding position heading into the US Open swing, where she will face a far deeper field.

items.en: UEFA Issues a Public Warning to FIFA Over Calendar and Competition Plans
items.zh: 歐洲足總公開向國際足總喊話，賽曆與賽事規劃再起爭端
items.summary: UEFA has issued a pointed warning to FIFA over fixture-calendar congestion and FIFA's expanding competition portfolio. The dispute is the latest round in a long institutional fight about who controls the global football schedule, with player unions and domestic leagues siding with UEFA on workload. Any escalation would land squarely on clubs already juggling expanded continental formats and an enlarged Club World Cup.

items.en: Three-Year Study of 4,000 Adults Finds Brain Health Can Improve at Any Age
items.zh: 近 4,000 人三年追蹤：任何年齡都能讓腦健康變好
items.summary: A three-year study following nearly 4,000 adults found that measurable brain health can improve at any age, challenging the assumption that cognitive sharpness only declines after early adulthood. Participants who changed sleep, exercise, social contact and cardiovascular risk factors showed gains rather than the expected drift downward. For students the practical read is that the same levers that protect ageing brains, especially sleep regularity and aerobic activity, also carry measurable academic upside.

items.en: Grandparents Emerge as a Protective Factor in Rising Youth Mental Health Problems
items.zh: 祖父母成為青少年心理健康的重要保護因子
items.summary: Researchers report that grandparents are an increasingly important protective factor for children's mental health as youth psychological distress continues to climb. Consistent contact with a non-parental trusted adult buffers stress and lowers reported anxiety, an effect that persists after controlling for family income. The finding is being read as an argument for treating extended-family contact as a modifiable public health variable rather than a lifestyle detail.

items.en: Campus Mental Health Research Points to Stigma, Cost and Access as the Real Barriers
items.zh: 校園心理健康研究：污名、費用與可近性才是真正門檻
items.summary: Synthesised campus mental health research identifies stigma, financial constraints and service accessibility, not awareness, as the dominant barriers keeping university students from support. Academic workload and performance pressure remain the leading reported causes of student distress. Interventions that shorten the path to a first appointment and remove per-session cost show the largest effect sizes, which matters for institutions weighing awareness campaigns against capacity investment.

items.en: HBM3e Contract Prices Jump Roughly 20% QoQ as CoWoS Stays Booked Through 2027
items.zh: HBM3e 合約價季增約 20%，台積電 CoWoS 產能已排到 2027 年
items.summary: HBM3e contract pricing rose about 20% quarter-on-quarter as SK hynix, Samsung and Micron allocate 2026 capacity against already-booked AI accelerator demand. HBM is now the single largest line item in modern accelerator bills of materials, which is why memory names are among 2026's biggest winners. TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging capacity is reported full through 2027, and TSMC has confirmed 2026 capex at the top of its $52-56 billion guidance range.

items.en: NVIDIA's Rubin Arrives in 2H 2026 on TSMC 3NP With HBM4; Feynman Targets A16
items.zh: NVIDIA Rubin 下半年上線，採台積電 3NP＋HBM4；Feynman 鎖定 A16
items.summary: NVIDIA's Rubin architecture launches in the second half of 2026, built by TSMC on a 3NP-class process with HBM4 support. Feynman, still in development for a 2028 launch, is reported to sit on TSMC's A16 node, which would make it NVIDIA's first volume part on a 1nm-class process. NVIDIA and TSMC have also begun deploying NVIDIA accelerated computing inside fabs for semiconductor design and manufacturing workloads.

items.en: Quantum Names Rally on Real Contracts: D-Wave +11% on Nasdaq Deal, IonQ Closes SkyWater Buyout
items.zh: 量子股靠實質合約走揚：D-Wave 因 Nasdaq 合作漲 11%，IonQ 完成收購 SkyWater
items.summary: D-Wave rose about 11% to $20.08 on a Nasdaq Verafin collaboration, IonQ gained roughly 9% to $39.62 after closing its SkyWater Technology acquisition, and Rigetti added about 9% to $16.23. The distinguishing feature of this leg of the quantum rally is that the catalysts are commercial agreements and vertical integration rather than pure research milestones. IonQ frames the SkyWater deal as building a domestic US quantum supply chain.

items.en: Vaundy Announces His First Asia Arena Tour 'HORO' With a Taipei Stop
items.zh: ★ Vaundy 首次亞洲巡迴「HORO」宣布，台北有場！
items.summary: Vaundy has announced his first Asia arena tour, 'HORO', opening September 5-6 in Chiba and running through November with dates in Seoul, Hong Kong, Taipei and Shanghai, followed by his largest-ever Japan arena tour in 2027-2028. He also completed the 'SILENCE' dome tour, which drew roughly 350,000 people, and announced a new song, 'Idea ga Afurete Nemurenai', as the theme for the Fuji TV Monday-9 drama. Exact Taipei on-sale timing has not been posted yet.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Set Their Sixth Album for September 30 and Their First Arena Tour in Three Years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯 9/30 發行，睽違三年巡迴同步啟動
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on September 30 and follow it with their first arena tour in three years, running across multiple Japanese cities from September through December 2026. The band is also staging 'CEREMONY 2026', a special Japan live event with an official overseas-visitor guide. No Taiwan or Hong Kong date has been announced, so the Japan legs are currently the only option for fans travelling from Taipei.

items.en: Fujii Kaze Runs the 'Pre: Prema Tour' Through August Before a November World Tour
items.zh: 藤井風「Pre: Prema Tour」8 月收尾，11 月起開跑世界巡演
items.summary: Fujii Kaze is playing the 'Pre: Prema Tour' from July into August 2026 with arena shows in Sapporo, Fukui and Hiroshima, positioned as a warm-up run. The full 'Prema World Tour' begins in November 2026. Asian dates for the world tour have not been fully itemised in the current schedule, so Taipei and Hong Kong fans should watch the official tour page rather than assume a stop. He is also on the North American arena circuit this cycle.

items.en: YOASOBI's 'NEVER ENDING STORIES' Becomes Their Biggest North American Run, Ending at the Hollywood Bowl
items.zh: YOASOBI「NEVER ENDING STORIES」成史上最大北美巡演，終點好萊塢露天劇場
items.summary: YOASOBI confirmed a return to North America with 'NEVER ENDING STORIES', their largest run there to date, hitting Barclays Center in Brooklyn and closing at the 20,000-capacity Hollywood Bowl with Crunchyroll backing. This sits alongside the previously announced Asia 10-city dome and stadium tour covering Taipei, Hong Kong, Seoul and Singapore. Taiwan and Hong Kong on-sale windows for the Asia leg still have not been fully disclosed, so lottery registration remains the thing to watch.
